decision.reason: [ev-fe0fca386a7a] calls `webhook.extraEnv` a new optional Helm value and does not say anything fails or changes by default. That would fit kind "none". But the semvalidate.values check refuted "added": it found `webhook.extraEnv` already in the v1.16.0 values file [ev-fdc96eee87bf] as well as in v1.17.0 [ev-717ddb6f40cd]. If the key existed before but the templates did not use it, environments that already set it would now get those environment variables, which would be a behavior-change rather than "none". Deciding this needs the actual `webhook.extraEnv` entries and webhook Deployment templates from both releases, because the excerpts shown contain only "# +docs:section=Global".
